productTitle: Men's Tassel Driving Moccasins with Segmented Rubber Soles
textDesc: Slip-on moc-toe shoes with double tassels, visible toe stitching and embossed surface texture. The actual photographs show five separate rubber contact pads and a small rear heel extension. Rubber outsole, PU lining and glued construction are specified by the source. Upper, midsole and insole compositions are not specified. Source colors are Red, Light Brown and Blue, with listed size labels 38-44; the Brown SKU corresponds to the pictured Light Brown shade. Fit and international size conversion are confirmed for the order. Send color-size quantities, destination, packing requirements and requested dispatch date for an order-specific quotation. No slip-resistance test, driving safety, handmade construction or ready-stock claim is made.
